correctness.rationale: The domain is a precisely specified finite cycle-membership concept class. Two independent maximal-independent-set enumerators agree for every n=3,...,16. Two exact memoized game recurrences (bitsets and immutable-set splitting) agree on all dimensions; exhaustive VC traces prove upper bounds, and full depth-5 and depth-6 leaf-labeled trees are replayed directly against all \(C_{13}\) and \(C_{16}\) hypotheses. The ranks at each smaller order are exhaustively computed; the all-s amplification follows a separate proof of additivity. Finite computation is used only for the finite part of the claim.

value.rationale: The cyclic maximal-independent-set concept class is a canonical non-monotone graph-solution class; thirteen is the sharp first cycle order where adaptive shattering exceeds static VC capacity. The gap vanishes at fourteen and fifteen and reappears at sixteen, giving a nontrivial boundary pattern. Verified exact adaptive certificates and an independent additivity argument produce an unbounded gap on two-regular disjoint unions. The finite cutoff is chosen by the first transition/reappearance, not an arbitrary size slice.
